# Economic Growth in the Global Esports Industry: Market Expansion, Revenue Dynamics, and Audience Trends (2010–2024)
## Keywords:
business, economics, sports industry, market growth, revenue dynamics, audience expansion, mobile esports, streaming platforms

## Abstract
This study considers the transformational nature of the global esports markets specifically from 2010 to 2024. During this timeframe, impressive growth can be seen in both revenue generated and audience viewing participation.
Indeed, the revenue has ballooned from $60 million to $4.3 billion, equating to a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 35.68%. In a similar way, the global viewing audience has grown from 5 million to 600 million viewers during the same timeframe, corresponding to a CAGR of 40.77%.
We established that a strong positive correlation (r=0.850, p<0.05) exists between audience viewing growth and revenue generation; this suggests that the esports market is becoming more efficient at generating revenue beyond the gamers themselves.
